corrections.label: Round, Hook & Button
corrections.was: Pointed waistband extension — a sharp nose angled 20° to 35° on a 5 cm to 15 cm tab.
corrections.now: Rounded waistband extension — a semicircular nose swept to a smooth 1.5 cm to 2.5 cm radius, closed with a hook and a button.
corrections.evidence: The option id and the description disagreed with the LABEL, the DRAWING and the supplier filename. Drawings opened and checked: 3413__Round_hook_btn.jpg shows a semicircular nose; 342A__Square_hook_btn.png shows a flat 90-degree end. The description had been written from the option id, which is a stale internal name.
